headline: The contest for Trevi: Icop lowers threshold to 55%; Webuild clarifies the issue of the €3.40
summary: Icop and Webuild, the two competing groups bidding for Trevi, have each issued statements in recent days. Icop has lowered its threshold to 55%, and Webuild has clarified the €3.40 figure.
why: Trevi is an Italian foundation engineering group, and a contested takeover in this sector typically draws attention from investors in Italian listed construction companies.

original_headline: La contesa per Trevi, Icop abbassa la soglia al 55%: Webuild chiarisce il nodo dei 3,40 euro
